about: NCEP AIGEFS (Project EAGLE) member forecast, completed by the SAME
cycle's physical global analysis.  Every document below is derived
from a proven parent, and the edits state exactly how it differs:
* the primary mapping starts from the cross-source fixture proven
against a real AI 0.25-degree 13-level atmosphere.  AIGEFS
publishes NO land surface at all (no soil, no land mask, no
orography, no skin temperature, no 2 m humidity in any form --
byte-measured 2026-08-17), so skin temperature and 2 m specific
humidity become composition_bound gaps and the fixture's dewpoint
field and its derivation disappear with them.  Every remaining
selector pins PDT 1: that is what refuses, at the mapped decode
itself, both a deterministic file (PDT 0, no ensemble identity)
and an ensemble statistic (PDT 2/12, which would decode cleanly
as plausible fields with nothing downstream able to tell).
* the donor mapping starts from the checked-in analysis mapping and
swaps its DERIVED 2 m specific humidity for the direct record the
analysis product publishes (0.1.0 at level 103/2, byte-measured in
the staged 2026-08-17 00Z file): a partitioned donor decode
refuses derived fields by design, so a borrowable field must be
directly selected.  The borrowed 2-D surface records pin PDT 0 --
a member-bearing donor already refuses by name in the engine, and
the pin states the same fact as selector identity.
* the composition starts from the proven cross-source fixture and
extends the one binding's field list with the extra gaps; its
soil selectors are the fixture's, unchanged.

value.source: NCEP AIGEFS (Project EAGLE) member forecast GRIB2 product, completed by a same-cycle physical global analysis
value.units_policy: terrain enters as the analysis product's surface geopotential height record in metres; no scale is applied
value.time_policy: the AI ensemble member supplies the evolving atmosphere at every forecast step; the borrowed land-surface state is the one analysis record of the SAME cycle, verified by the composition's source_cycle_analysis_broadcast alignment and carried unchanged to every primary valid time, with the carried times named in the receipt
value.member_policy: member identity belongs to the PRIMARY files and is verified by the packaged rw-wps.members.v1 grammar at member preparation; the contributing analysis is deterministic and a member-bearing donor refuses by name
value.absence_policy: the member product publishes no soil temperature, no soil moisture, no land mask, no orography, no skin temperature and no 2 m humidity (byte-measured, 2026-08-17 00Z cycle); every one of those gaps is declared composition_bound in the primary mapping and bound to the analysis donor -- nothing is synthesized
